INVESTIGATION_BOARD.SETTINGS.CasesFolder: File Journals in a Cases Folder
Keep the cases, handouts and sealed entries this module creates in their own journal folder instead of at the top of the journal directory. The folder can be renamed freely.
INVESTIGATION_BOARD.SETTINGS.MonsterHunt: Adds the GM's deduction tracker (Who, What, When, Where, Why) from Monster Hunters 2: The Mission, and lets the GM stamp clues with the deduction they feed. Everything but the stamps stays on the GM's side.
